name: Daybright Lance
description: Hurl a lance of unclouded day through the body of a foe and the guard behind it.

name: Aureate Guard
description: Raise a golden guard over the user and nearby allies that holds against heavy assault.

name: Dawn Resurgence
description: Call back an ally whose life has just left by pouring the first light of a new day into the chest.

name: Gilded Scourge
description: Sweep a scourge of gold fire across the field in a wide scorching arc.

name: Solar Crown
description: Set a crown of the sun's rim on the user and loose it as a ring of fire on all sides.

name: Radiant Absorption
description: Draw the full force of a great blow into the user's light and keep it there as warmth.

name: Lightborne Phase
description: Become a ray of light for an instant and pass through a solid obstacle to the far side.

name: Sunseal Decree
description: Stamp a seal of daylight on the qi of a foe and lock the techniques it can call.

name: Unsetting Ray
description: The school's high stroke in which a single ray of the day holds its line without fading however long it must run.

name: Dayspring Mercy
description: The school's gift of mercy in which a spring of day wells up under the wounded and fills them with strength.

name: Sovereign Daylight
description: The school's rule of light in which a ruling brightness bows every lesser will in its reach.

name: Sunflood Ruin
description: Pour a flood of the sun over the whole field and scorch it to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Unsetting Sun
description: Hold the sun fixed above the field so that it does not set while the user lives and no shadow falls within it and nothing in its light can end in darkness. A successful use is a consequence event.
